# Receipt rollout compatibility masked by forward-looking mocks
P1 pattern from enhanced-settings task 1 isolated review: replacing a legacy-success mock with a future receipt response can hide a cross-repository protocol regression. In a local comparison against the supported provider snapshot, the previous client reported success while the staged client raised after exactly the same values had already been persisted. The unit test passed. Review client increments against the actual supported release source, and verify both the write and caller-visible outcome; successful persistence alone does not demonstrate end-to-end compatibility. Receipt enforcement should be negotiated or enabled only on a supported protocol path. Evidence: client.py:5 and tests/test_client.py:8, with provider/settings.py extracted from eval-release.
